captions.detailed: A 35mm cinema prime lens featuring a matte black cylindrical body with a flared front element housing a dark glass lens. Around its middle is a ridged, rotatable focus ring, and at the rear is a metallic silver PL-mount locking ring with small rectangular tabs. The focus ring rotates continuously around the central optical axis, while the metallic PL ring rotates to lock the mount.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a 35mm cinema prime lens with a matte black flared body, a rotatable focus ring with vertical ridges, and a silver PL mount locking ring at the rear. The focus ring should rotate on a revolute joint around the central axis, and the PL locking ring should also rotate on its own revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens body using a combination of cylinder primitives and a loft or flared cylinder for the front element. Model the focus ring as a larger-diameter cylinder, pattern vertical rectangular ridges around its circumference, and mount it to the main body using a continuous or revolute joint. Create the PL locking ring at the base using a thin metallic cylinder, add locking tabs, and connect it with a revolute joint.
